The desktop reconnection status-transition test moved to Rust; Python tests now exercise the native source rather than assigning scheduler state. Update URL-open monkeypatch tests moved to native transport fixtures; Python retains public API checks and adds native hardlink rejection. Seven native update unit tests cover the replaced transport cases and real TLS.
